descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you a motivated, analytically minded professional who thrives at the intersection of strategy, operations, and collaboration? Do you get energized by turning complex data into clear insights and helping high-performing teams run at their best? If so, this could be the role for you.

About the Role

As an Operations Analyst within the L&H Executive Office, you will be a key enabler of operational excellence across the Americas Market Units of L&H Re, P&C Re and the In-Force Optimization team. Working closely with the Department Operations Officers (DOOs), you will contribute to a wide range of strategic and operational priorities — from performance reporting and governance to executive communications, event management, to audit coordination and operational risk management. This is a dynamic, high-visibility role in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where your work will help provide information and coordination to support leadership decision-making and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

• Support operational, governance, planning, and business management activities across the Canada and US Market Units and the In-Force Optimization team, working with stakeholders across L&H and the Canadian Composite Market in North America.

• Prepare and maintain standard reports, ensuring timely availability of key performance indicators to support leadership steering and performance monitoring

• Develop high-quality presentation materials for management meetings, committee updates, town halls, internal and external events, team offsites, and communication packages

• Provide qualitative and quantitative analysis on key operational topics, including cost management and follow-up on operational risk mitigation actions

• Support change management and performance management initiatives, including executive presentation preparation and implementation of strategic priorities

• Leverage AI and digital productivity tools to analyze information, create content, automate routine activities, and continuously improve ways of working

• Collate and synthesize internal and external data, translating findings into actionable recommendations that support business decisions

• Assist with governance-related activities, including compliance topics, records management, control evidence collection, action tracking, and follow-up on key business commitments

• Contribute to employee engagement programs and event management, helping foster a connected and motivated team culture

• Take on ad hoc tasks and evolving responsibilities as business needs arise, demonstrating agility and a solutions-oriented mindset

About the Team

The L&H Executive Office sits within the L&H Re Division Operations & Advisory and serves as the strategic and operational backbone for the Americas Market Units. The Department Operations Officers (DOOs) act as trusted business partners to the Managing Directors and their leadership teams, driving and supporting a diverse range of topics — from strategy and operations to people and culture. As an Operations Analyst, you will be an individual contributor reporting to the Lead DOO L&H North America, embedded in a team that is intellectually curious, collaborative, and deeply committed to enabling the business to operate at its best.

About You

You are a self-starter who brings integrity, curiosity, and a collaborative spirit to everything you do. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing multiple priorities, and engaging with stakeholders across all levels of a global organization. You combine strong analytical skills with clear communication, and you are passionate about using data and digital tools to drive smarter, faster decisions.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience.

• Strong analytical and financial acumen — ability to work with diverse data sources, draw meaningful insights, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations

• Proficiency in Microsoft 365 applications — including Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and Copilot, with demonstrated ability to produce polished, executive-ready materials

• Project management and planning skills — proven ability to coordinate and support the execution of a portfolio of activities across multi-functional and global teams

• Stakeholder management and communication skills — ability to build effective working relationships across teams, functions, and levels of the organization, handling sensitive and critical information with discretion

• Comfort with AI and digital productivity tools — experience using technology to analyze information, automate routine tasks, and continuously improve ways of working

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience working in the re/insurance industry with a solid understanding of the Life & Health business

• Familiarity with reporting, visualization, automation, and productivity tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, SQL, Access, or Stargate

• Knowledge of Swiss Re information and reporting systems

• Experience supporting governance, compliance, or audit-related activities in a corporate environment

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
The base salary hiring range for this new position is CAD $75,000-$110,000 . The specific base salary offered for this or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.

About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Sind Sie ein motivierter, analytisch denkender Fachmann, der an der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Betrieb und Zusammenarbeit gedeiht? Werden Sie energetisiert, indem Sie komplexe Daten in klare Erkenntnisse verwandeln und leistungsstarken Teams helfen, von ihrer besten Seite zu laufen? Wenn ja, könnte dies die Rolle für Sie sein.

Über die Rolle

Als Operations Analyst im L&H Executive Office sind Sie ein wichtiger Wegbereiter für operative Exzellenz in den amerikanischen Markteinheiten von L&H Re, P&C Re und dem In-Force Optimization Team. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Department Operations Officers (DOOs) leisten Sie einen Beitrag zu einer Vielzahl von strategischen und operativen Prioritäten - von der Leistungsberichterstattung und Governance über die Kommunikation der Führungskräfte, das Eventmanagement bis hin zur Auditkoordination und zum Management des operativen Risikos. Dies ist eine dynamische, hoch sichtbare Rolle in einer schnelllebigen, kollaborativen Umgebung, in der Ihre Arbeit dazu beiträgt, Informationen und Koordination bereitzustellen, um die Entscheidungsfindung und die Geschäftsergebnisse von Führungskräften zu unterstützen.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Unterstützen Sie operative, Governance-, Planungs- und Business-Management-Aktivitäten in den kanadischen und US-amerikanischen Markteinheiten sowie das In-Force-Optimierungsteam und arbeiten Sie mit Stakeholdern in L & H und dem Canadian Composite Market in Nordamerika zusammen.

• Erstellung und Pflege von Standardberichten, um die rechtzeitige Verfügbarkeit der wichtigsten Leistungsindikatoren zur Unterstützung der Führung und der Leistungsüberwachung zu gewährleisten

• Entwicklung hochwertiger Präsentationsmaterialien für Management-Meetings, Ausschussaktualisierungen, Rathäuser, interne und externe Veranstaltungen, Team-Offsites und Kommunikationspakete

• Bereitstellung einer qualitativen und quantitativen Analyse zu wichtigen operativen Themen, einschließlich Kostenmanagement und Folgemaßnahmen zur Minderung des operationellen Risikos

• Unterstützung von Change-Management- und Performance-Management-Initiativen, einschließlich der Vorbereitung von Executive-Präsentationen und der Umsetzung strategischer Prioritäten

• Nutzen Sie KI und digitale Produktivitätstools, um Informationen zu analysieren, Inhalte zu erstellen, Routineaktivitäten zu automatisieren und die Arbeitsweise kontinuierlich zu verbessern

• Zusammenstellen und Synthetisieren von internen und externen Daten, Übersetzen von Erkenntnissen in umsetzbare Empfehlungen, die Geschäftsentscheidungen unterstützen

• Unterstützung bei Governance-bezogenen Aktivitäten, einschließlich Compliance-Themen, Records Management, Kontrolle der Evidenzsammlung, Maßnahmenverfolgung und Follow-up zu wichtigen Geschäftsverpflichtungen

• Beitrag zu Mitarbeiterbindungsprogrammen und Eventmanagement, um eine vernetzte und motivierte Teamkultur zu fördern

• Übernehmen Sie Ad-hoc-Aufgaben und sich entwickelnde Verantwortlichkeiten, wenn Geschäftsanforderungen entstehen, und zeigen Sie Agilität und eine lösungsorientierte Denkweise

Über das Team

Das L&H Executive Office ist Teil der L&H Re Division Operations & Advisory und dient als strategisches und operatives Rückgrat der Americas Market Units. Die Department Operations Officers (DOOs) fungieren als vertrauenswürdige Geschäftspartner für die Geschäftsführer und ihre Führungsteams und fördern und unterstützen eine Vielzahl von Themen - von Strategie und Betrieb bis hin zu Menschen und Kultur. Als Operations Analyst sind Sie ein individueller Mitwirkender, der an den Lead DOO L&H North America berichtet, eingebettet in ein Team, das intellektuell neugierig, kollaborativ und engagiert ist, damit das Unternehmen optimal arbeiten kann.

Über dich

Du bist ein Selbststarter, der Integrität, Neugier und einen kooperativen Geist in alles bringt, was du tust. Sie navigieren gerne Mehrdeutigkeiten, verwalten mehrere Prioritäten und engagieren sich mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen einer globalen Organisation. Sie kombinieren starke analytische Fähigkeiten mit klarer Kommunikation und sind begeistert von der Verwendung von Daten und digitalen Tools, um intelligentere und schnellere Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Wir suchen Kandidaten, die diese Anforderungen erfüllen:

• Bachelor-Abschluss in einem relevanten Bereich oder gleichwertige Berufserfahrung.

• Starker analytischer und finanzieller Scharfsinn - Fähigkeit, mit verschiedenen Datenquellen zu arbeiten, aussagekräftige Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen und Erkenntnisse in klare, umsetzbare Empfehlungen zu übersetzen

• Kenntnisse in Microsoft 365-Anwendungen - einschließlich Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint und Copilot - mit nachgewiesener Fähigkeit, polierte, führungsfähige Materialien zu erstellen

• Projektmanagement- und Planungsfähigkeiten — nachgewiesene Fähigkeit zur Koordination und Unterstützung der Durchführung eines Portfolios von Aktivitäten in multifunktionalen und globalen Teams

• Stakeholder-Management- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten - Fähigkeit, effektive Arbeitsbeziehungen zwischen Teams, Funktionen und Ebenen der Organisation aufzubauen und sensible und kritische Informationen diskret zu behandeln

• Komfort mit KI und digitalen Produktivitätstools - Erfahrung mit Technologie zur Analyse von Informationen, zur Automatisierung von Routineaufgaben und zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Arbeitsweise

Dies sind zusätzliche nett zu haben:

• Erfahrung in der Rück- / Versicherungsbranche mit einem soliden Verständnis des Life & Health-Geschäfts

• Vertrautheit mit Reporting, Visualisierung, Automatisierung und Produktivitätstools wie Power BI, Power Automate, SQL, Access oder Stargate

• Kenntnisse der Informations- und Meldesysteme von Swiss Re

• Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von Governance-, Compliance- oder Audit-bezogenen Aktivitäten in einem Unternehmensumfeld

Unser Unternehmen hat ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, bei dem erwartet wird, dass Sie mindestens drei Tage pro Woche im Büro sind.
Die Grundgehaltsspanne für diese neue Position beträgt 75.000 bis 110.000 CAD. Das spezifische Grundgehalt, das für diese oder eine bestimmte Rolle angeboten wird, berücksichtigt eine Reihe von Faktoren, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf den Arbeitsplatz, den Umfang der Rolle, die Qualifikationen, die Komplexität / Spezialisierung / Knappheit von Talenten, Erfahrung, Ausbildung und Arbeitgeberbudget. Bei Swiss Re verfolgen wir einen "Gesamtvergütungsansatz", wenn wir Entschädigungsentscheidungen treffen. Dies bedeutet, dass wir alle Komponenten der Entschädigung in ihrer Gesamtheit (wie Grundvergütung, kurz- und langfristige Anreize und angebotene Leistungen) bei der Festlegung der individuellen Entschädigung berücksichtigen.

Über Swiss Re
Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. Wir antizipieren und managen eine Vielzahl von Risiken, von Naturkatastrophen und Klimawandel bis hin zu Cyberkriminalität. Wir decken sowohl Eigentum & Unfall und Leben & Gesundheit. Durch die Kombination von Erfahrung mit kreativem Denken und modernster Expertise schaffen wir neue Möglichkeiten und Lösungen für unsere Kunden. Dies ist dank der Zusammenarbeit von mehr als 15.000 Mitarbeitern auf der ganzen Welt möglich.

Unser Erfolg hängt von unserer Fähigkeit ab, eine integrative Kultur aufzubauen, die neue Perspektiven und innovatives Denken fördert. Wir nehmen einen Arbeitsplatz an, an dem jeder die gleichen Chancen hat, beruflich zu gedeihen und sich zu entwickeln, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Rasse, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Geschlechtsidentität und / oder Ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, körperlicher oder geistiger Fähigkeit, Fähigkeiten, Gedanken oder anderen Eigenschaften. In unserem integrativen und flexiblen Umfeld kann jeder sein authentisches Selbst und seine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit mitbringen.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener Profi sind, der nach einer Berufspause in die Belegschaft zurückkehrt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich für offene Stellen zu bewerben, die Ihren Fähigkeiten und Ihrer Erfahrung entsprechen.

Schweizer Re ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Es ist unsere Praxis, ohne Rücksicht auf Rasse, Religion, Hautfarbe, nationale Herkunft, Geschlecht, Behinderung, Alter, Schwangerschaft, sexuelle Orientierungen, Familienstand, Militärstatus oder andere gesetzlich geschützte Merkmale zu rekrutieren, einzustellen und zu fördern. Entscheidungen über die Beschäftigung basieren ausschließlich auf den Qualifikationen einer Person für die zu besetzende Stelle.

Während des Rekrutierungsprozesses sind angemessene Unterkünfte für Behinderungen auf Anfrage verfügbar. Wenn Sie für ein Interview kontaktiert werden, informieren Sie bitte den Recruiter / HR Professional über die erforderliche Unterkunft.

Wir können KI-basierte Tools verwenden, um die Überprüfung und Bewertung von Anwendungen für diese Position zu unterstützen. Diese Tools bieten unseren Rekrutierungsteams zusätzliche Einblicke, aber alle Einstellungsentscheidungen werden sorgfältig überprüft und von Menschen getroffen. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, wie wir KI bei der Rekrutierung einsetzen und wie wir mit Ihren personenbezogenen Daten umgehen, lesen Sie bitte unsere Datenschutzerklärung, bevor Sie sich bewerben.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous un professionnel motivé et analytique qui prospère à l'intersection de la stratégie, des opérations et de la collaboration? Est-ce que vous êtes sous tension en transformant des données complexes en idées claires et en aidant les équipes performantes à fonctionner à leur meilleur? Si oui, cela pourrait être votre rôle.

À propos du rôle

En tant qu'analyste des opérations au sein du bureau de direction de L&H, vous serez un catalyseur clé de l'excellence opérationnelle dans les unités de marché des Amériques de L&H Re, de P&C Re et de l'équipe d'optimisation en force. En étroite collaboration avec les agents des opérations du Ministère, vous contribuerez à un large éventail de priorités stratégiques et opérationnelles, allant de l'établissement de rapports sur le rendement et de la gouvernance aux communications avec les cadres supérieurs, à la gestion des événements, à la coordination de la vérification et à la gestion des risques opérationnels. Il s'agit d'un rôle dynamique et de grande visibilité dans un environnement de collaboration rapide où votre travail aidera à fournir de l'information et de la coordination pour appuyer la prise de décisions en matière de leadership et les résultats opérationnels.

Principales responsabilités

• Appuyer les activités opérationnelles, de gouvernance, de planification et de gestion des affaires à l'échelle des unités de marché du Canada et des États-Unis et de l'équipe d'optimisation des forces, en collaboration avec les intervenants de L&H et du marché composite canadien en Amérique du Nord.

• Élaborer et tenir à jour des rapports normalisés, en veillant à ce que les principaux indicateurs de rendement soient disponibles en temps opportun pour appuyer la direction et le suivi du rendement

• Élaborer des documents de présentation de haute qualité pour les réunions de gestion, les mises à jour des comités, les mairies, les événements internes et externes, les équipes hors site et les dossiers de communication

• Fournir une analyse qualitative et quantitative des principaux sujets opérationnels, y compris la gestion des coûts et le suivi des mesures d'atténuation des risques opérationnels

• Appuyer les initiatives de gestion du changement et de gestion du rendement, y compris la préparation et la mise en oeuvre des priorités stratégiques

• Tirer parti des outils d'IA et de productivité numérique pour analyser l'information, créer du contenu, automatiser les activités de routine et améliorer continuellement les méthodes de travail

• Rassembler et synthétiser les données internes et externes, en transformant les conclusions en recommandations concrètes à l'appui des décisions des entreprises

• Aider aux activités liées à la gouvernance, y compris les questions de conformité, la gestion des dossiers, la collecte des données de contrôle, le suivi des mesures et le suivi des principaux engagements opérationnels

• Contribuer aux programmes d'engagement des employés et à la gestion des événements, en favorisant une culture d'équipe connectée et motivée

• Assumer des tâches ponctuelles et des responsabilités en évolution au fur et à mesure que les besoins des entreprises se font sentir, en faisant preuve d'agilité et d'un état d'esprit orienté vers les solutions

À propos de l'équipe

Le Bureau exécutif de L&H siège au sein de la Division des opérations et des conseils de L&H et sert de base stratégique et opérationnelle aux unités de marché des Amériques. Les agents des opérations du Ministère agissent en tant que partenaires commerciaux de confiance auprès des directeurs généraux et de leurs équipes de direction, en dirigeant et en appuyant un éventail de sujets, allant de la stratégie et des opérations aux personnes et à la culture. En tant qu'analyste des opérations, vous serez un contributeur individuel relevant du chef de file DOO L&H Amérique du Nord, intégré dans une équipe intellectuellement curieuse, collaborative et profondément engagée à permettre à l'entreprise de fonctionner à son meilleur.

À propos de toi

Vous êtes un autodidacte qui apporte intégrité, curiosité et esprit de collaboration à tout ce que vous faites. Vous êtes à l'aise pour naviguer l'ambiguïté, gérer plusieurs priorités, et dialoguer avec les intervenants à tous les niveaux d'une organisation mondiale. Vous combinez de solides compétences analytiques avec une communication claire, et vous êtes passionné par l'utilisation de données et d'outils numériques pour conduire des décisions plus intelligentes et plus rapides.

Nous cherchons des candidats qui répondent à ces exigences :

• Baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent ou expérience professionnelle équivalente.

• Forte acuité analytique et financière — capacité de travailler avec diverses sources de données, de tirer des conclusions utiles et de traduire les conclusions en recommandations claires et réalisables

• Compétence dans les applications Microsoft 365 — y compris les équipes, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint et Copilot, avec une capacité démontrée de produire des matériaux polis et prêts à l'emploi

• Compétences en matière de gestion et de planification de projets — Capacité avérée de coordonner et d'appuyer l'exécution d'un portefeuille d'activités au sein d'équipes multifonctionnelles et mondiales

• Compétences en gestion et en communication des intervenants – capacité d'établir des relations de travail efficaces entre les équipes, les fonctions et les niveaux de l'organisation, de traiter les renseignements sensibles et critiques avec discrétion

• Confort avec l'IA et les outils de productivité numérique — expérience utilisant la technologie pour analyser l'information, automatiser les tâches de routine et améliorer continuellement les méthodes de travail

Ce sont des avantages supplémentaires à avoir:

• Expérience de travail dans l'industrie de la réassurance et de l'assurance avec une bonne compréhension de l'activité Vie et santé

• Familiarité avec les outils de reporting, de visualisation, d'automatisation et de productivité tels que Power BI, Power Automate, SQL, Access ou Stargate

• Connaissance des systèmes d'information et de rapport Swiss Re

• Expérience en matière de gouvernance, de conformité ou d'activités liées à la vérification dans un environnement organisationnel

Notre entreprise a un modèle de travail hybride où l'on s'attend à ce que vous soyez au bureau au moins trois jours par semaine.
L'échelle salariale de base pour ce nouveau poste est de 75 000 $CAN à 110 000 $. Le salaire de base spécifique offert pour ce rôle ou un tel rôle tiendra compte d'un certain nombre de facteurs, y compris, sans s'y limiter, le lieu d'affectation, l'étendue du rôle, les qualifications, la complexité, la spécialisation et la rareté des talents, l'expérience, les études et le budget de l'employeur. Chez Swiss Re, nous adoptons une «approche de la rémunération totale» pour prendre des décisions en matière de rémunération. Cela signifie que nous considérons toutes les composantes de la rémunération dans leur ensemble (comme la rémunération de base, les incitatifs à court et à long terme et les avantages offerts) dans l'établissement de la rémunération individuelle.

À propos de Swiss Re
Suisse Re est l'un des principaux fournisseurs de réassurance, d'assurance et d'autres formes de transfert de risque fondé sur l'assurance, travaillant à rendre le monde plus résilient. Nous anticipons et gérons une grande variété de risques, des catastrophes naturelles et du changement climatique à la cybercriminalité. Nous couvrons à la fois Propriété & Casualty et Vie & Santé. Combinant l'expérience avec la pensée créative et l'expertise de pointe, nous créons de nouvelles opportunités et solutions pour nos clients. Cela est possible grâce à la collaboration de plus de 15 000 employés à travers le monde.

Notre succès dépend de notre capacité à bâtir une culture inclusive favorisant de nouvelles perspectives et une pensée novatrice. Nous embrassons un lieu de travail où chacun a les mêmes chances de prospérer et de se développer professionnellement, quel que soit son âge, son sexe, sa race, son appartenance ethnique, son identité et/ou son expression, son orientation sexuelle, ses aptitudes physiques ou mentales, ses compétences, sa pensée ou d'autres caractéristiques. Dans notre environnement inclusif et flexible, tout le monde peut apporter son authentique soi au travail et sa passion pour la durabilité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté qui revient au marché du travail après une interruption de carrière, nous vous encourageons à postuler à des postes ouverts qui correspondent à vos compétences et à votre expérience.

Suisse Re est un employeur à chances égales. Notre pratique consiste à recruter, embaucher et promouvoir sans égard à la race, à la religion, à la couleur, à l'origine nationale, au sexe, au handicap, à l'âge, à la grossesse, à l'orientation sexuelle, à l'état civil, à l'état militaire ou à toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi. Les décisions relatives à l'emploi sont fondées uniquement sur les qualifications d'une personne pour le poste à pourvoir.

Pendant le processus de recrutement, des aménagements raisonnables sont disponibles sur demande. Si vous êtes contacté pour une entrevue, veuillez informer le recruteur/professionnel des RH de l'accommodement nécessaire.

Nous pouvons utiliser des outils alimentés par l'IA pour appuyer l'examen et l'évaluation des demandes pour ce poste. Ces outils fournissent des renseignements supplémentaires à nos équipes de recrutement, mais toutes les décisions d'embauche sont soigneusement examinées et prises par les gens. Pour en savoir plus sur la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans le recrutement et comment nous traitons vos données personnelles, veuillez consulter notre Déclaration de confidentialité des données avant de postuler.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei pronto a svolgere un ruolo fondamentale nella definizione del futuro della riassicurazione facoltativa in tutta la regione Asia-Pacifico? Se avete una passione per la riassicurazione P&C, un occhio affilato per i dettagli, e prosperare in un ambiente collaborativo e veloce - questa è l'opportunità che state aspettando!

Informazioni sul ruolo

In qualità di Coordinatore di scrittura FAC I, sarai al centro delle operazioni di sottoscrizione di Swiss Re's Business Services - P&C Facultative, lavorando a stretto contatto con gli scrittori regionali per fornire un supporto preciso, tempestivo e di alta qualità nei mercati APAC. I vostri contributi influenzeranno direttamente la produttività, l'efficienza e la redditività del processo di sottoscrizione, rendendo il vostro lavoro sia significativo che di impatto.

Principali responsabilità

• Comprendere e supportare il processo di sottoscrizione P&C FAC end-to-end fornendo assistenza tecnica e operativa agli strumenti P&C FAC di APAC, garantendo un flusso di lavoro senza soluzione di continuità e continuità aziendale

• Maneggiare sottomissioni e attività di pre-sottoscrittura eseguendo controlli approfonditi sul rischio e sulla conformità (AML, ITC), istituendo rischi di riassicurazione nei sistemi Swiss Re, e i rischi vincolanti negli strumenti secondo i termini definitivi concordati

• Coordinare efficacemente con FAC P&C Desk Underwriters, FAC Hub Bangalore, e membri del team cross-funzionali per garantire la consegna tempestiva e accurata delle uscite aziendali

• Costruire e nutrire forti relazioni con le parti interessate, cercando proattivamente un feedback per guidare un miglioramento continuo sia per la crescita individuale che di team

• Superare i processi di Business Services per garantire l'efficacia del processo end-to-end, identificare le opportunità di miglioramento e implementare le migliori pratiche

• Monitorare le prestazioni del portafoglio, tra cui la qualità dei dati, la tempestività e gli obiettivi chiave, garantendo precisione e aderenza agli standard stabiliti

• Valutare e migliorare i processi aziendali individuando inefficienze e contribuendo a iniziative di miglioramento del processo che rafforzano l'eccellenza operativa

• Assistere nei processi Pre-Quote e Post Bind con costi di rinnovo semplici (ad esempio: Roll forward & Empowered Pricing).

Informazioni sulla squadra

Il team di Business Services Facultative P&C APAC è un gruppo dinamico, multinazionale e altamente impegnato che lavora direttamente con e supporta i team di sottoscrittura rivolti al cliente nei mercati Asia-Pacifico. Organizzato in sub-team più piccoli e focalizzati allineati a specifici mercati APAC, operiamo come un team unificato - condividere conoscenze, espandere la nostra esperienza di riassicurazione e fornire un servizio eccellente ai nostri clienti interni. Siamo guidati da un impegno condiviso per lo sviluppo professionale, la collaborazione e la passione per fare una vera e propria differenza nel paesaggio di riassicurazione.

I nostri valori di squadra sono al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo: Client Centricity, Integrity, Passion to Perform, Team Spirit e Agility. Se queste risonano con te, ti sentirai a casa qui.

A proposito di te

Sei un professionista motivato e orientato al dettaglio con una solida base di riassicurazione facoltativa e un autentico entusiasmo per l'eccellenza operativa. Porti una mentalità collaborativa, sensibilità culturale, e l'adattabilità a prosperare in un ambiente globalmente connesso. Si prende la proprietà del vostro lavoro, comunicare con chiarezza e fiducia, e sono sempre alla ricerca di modi per crescere e contribuire al successo della squadra.

Siamo alla ricerca di candidati che soddisfano questi requisiti:

• 3-5 anni di esperienza nel settore delle assicurazioni o della riassicurazione, con un record solido nei ruoli dei servizi operativi o aziendali

Solida comprensione dei principi di assicurazione Proprietà/Casualità facoltativi, compreso il flusso di processo di sottoscrizione end-to-end e una forte conoscenza di lavoro dei concetti di riassicurazione P&C

Proficienza in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), con la capacità di sfruttare questi strumenti in modo efficace per la gestione dei dati, reporting e comunicazione

Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese, con la capacità di trasmettere informazioni complesse in modo chiaro e conciso in diverse squadre distribuite a livello globale

Forte attenzione al cliente e orientamento al servizio, con un track record di costruzione e mantenere relazioni di stakeholder produttive

Capacità di adattarsi rapidamente ai cambiamenti di attività, priorità e ambienti aziendali

Flessibilità e disponibilità a lavorare durante le ore di fuso orario APAC per sostenere le esigenze aziendali regionali

Esperienza con controlli correlati alla conformità come AML e ITC in un contesto di assicurazione o di riassicurazione

La nostra azienda ha un modello di lavoro ibrido in cui l'aspettativa è che sarete in ufficio almeno tre giorni alla settimana.

Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Copriamo sia Proprietà & Casuale e Vita & Salute. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.
Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

Are you ready to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of facultative reinsurance across the Asia-Pacific region? If you have a passion for P&C reinsurance, a sharp eye for detail, and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment — this is the opportunity you've been waiting for!

About the Role

As a FAC Underwriting Coordinator I, you will be at the heart of Swiss Re's Business Services - P&C Facultative underwriting operations, working closely with regional underwriters to deliver precise, timely, and high-quality support across the APAC markets. Your contributions will directly influence the productivity, efficiency, and profitability of the underwriting process — making your work both meaningful and impactful.

Key Responsibilities

• Understand and support the end-to-end P&C FAC underwriting process by providing both technical and operational assistance to APAC's P&C FAC Underwriters, ensuring seamless workflow and business continuity

• Handle submissions and pre-underwriting activities by performing thorough risk clearing and compliance-related checks (AML, ITC), setting up reinsurance risks in Swiss Re systems, and binding risks in tools as per final agreed terms

• Coordinate effectively with FAC P&C Desk Underwriters, FAC Hub Bangalore, and cross- functional team members to ensure timely and accurate delivery of business outputs

• Build and nurture strong stakeholder relationships, proactively seeking feedback to drive continuous improvement for both individual and team growth

• Oversee Business Services processes to ensure end-to-end process effectiveness, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing best practices

• Monitor portfolio performance including data quality, timeliness, and key targets, ensuring accuracy and adherence to established standards

• Evaluate and enhance business processes by identifying inefficiencies and contributing to process improvement initiatives that strengthen operational excellence

• Assist in Pre-Quote and Post Bind processes with simple renewal costing (e.g.: Roll forward & Empowered Pricing).

About the Team

The Business Services Facultative P&C APAC team is a dynamic, multinational, and highly engaged group that works directly with and supports client-facing underwriting teams across Asia- Pacific markets. Organized into smaller, focused sub-teams aligned to specific APAC markets, we operate as one unified team — sharing knowledge, expanding our reinsurance expertise, and delivering excellent service to our internal clients. We are driven by a shared commitment to professional development, collaboration, and a passion for making a real difference in the reinsurance landscape.

Our team values are at the core of everything we do: Client Centricity, Integrity, Passion to Perform, Team Spirit, and Agility. If these resonate with you, you'll feel right at home here

About You

You are a motivated, detail-oriented professional with a solid grounding in facultative reinsurance and a genuine enthusiasm for operational excellence. You bring a collaborative mindset, cultural sensitivity, and the adaptability to thrive in a globally connected environment. You take ownership of your work, communicate with clarity and confidence, and are always looking for ways to grow and contribute to the team's success.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• 3-5 years of experience in the Insurance or Reinsurance industry, with a solid track record in operational or business services roles

Solid understanding of Facultative Property/Casualty insurance principles, including end-to- end underwriting process flow and a strong working knowledge of P&C reinsurance concepts

Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), with the ability to leverage these tools effectively for data management, reporting, and communication

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely across diverse, globally distributed teams

Strong customer-focus and service orientation, with a track record of building and maintaining productive stakeholder relationships

Ability to adapt quickly to changing tasks, priorities, and business environments

Flexibility and willingness to work during APAC time zone hours to support regional business needs

Experience with compliance-related checks such as AML and ITC in an insurance or reinsurance context

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Sind Sie bereit, eine zentrale Rolle bei der Gestaltung der Zukunft der fakultativen Rückversicherung in der Region Asien-Pazifik zu spielen? Wenn Sie eine Leidenschaft für P & C-Rückversicherung haben, ein scharfes Auge für Details haben und in einer kollaborativen, schnelllebigen Umgebung gedeihen - das ist die Gelegenheit, auf die Sie gewartet haben!

Über die Rolle

Als FAC Underwriting Coordinator I stehen Sie im Mittelpunkt der Business Services - P&C Facultative Underwriting-Aktivitäten von Swiss Re und arbeiten eng mit regionalen Underwritern zusammen, um präzise, zeitnahe und qualitativ hochwertige Unterstützung in den APAC-Märkten zu bieten. Ihre Beiträge beeinflussen direkt die Produktivität, Effizienz und Rentabilität des Zeichnungsprozesses und machen Ihre Arbeit sowohl sinnvoll als auch wirkungsvoll.

Hauptzuständigkeiten

• Bearbeitung von Einreichungen und Pre-Underwriting-Aktivitäten durch gründliche Risiko-Clearing- und Compliance-bezogene Prüfungen (AML, ITC), Aufbau von Rückversicherungsrisiken in Swiss Re-Systemen und verbindliche Risiken in Tools gemäß den endgültig vereinbarten Bedingungen

• Bewerten und verbessern Sie Geschäftsprozesse, indem Sie Ineffizienzen identifizieren und zu Prozessverbesserungsinitiativen beitragen, die die operative Exzellenz stärken

• Unterstützung bei Pre-Quote- und Post-Bind-Prozessen mit einfacher Erneuerungskalkulation (z. B. Roll forward & Empowered Pricing).

Über das Team

Das Business Services Facultative P&C APAC-Team ist eine dynamische, multinationale und hoch engagierte Gruppe, die direkt mit Kundenteams in den asiatisch-pazifischen Märkten zusammenarbeitet und diese unterstützt. Wir werden von einem gemeinsamen Engagement für die berufliche Entwicklung, die Zusammenarbeit und die Leidenschaft für einen echten Unterschied in der Rückversicherungslandschaft angetrieben.

Unsere Teamwerte stehen im Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun: Client Centricity, Integrity, Passion to Perform, Team Spirit und Agilität. Wenn diese mit dir in Resonanz sind, wirst du dich hier wie zu Hause fühlen

Über dich

Sie sind ein motivierter, detailorientierter Fachmann mit einer soliden Basis in der fakultativen Rückversicherung und einer echten Begeisterung für operative Exzellenz. Sie bringen eine kollaborative Denkweise, kulturelle Sensibilität und die Anpassungsfähigkeit mit, um in einer global vernetzten Umgebung zu gedeihen. Starke Kundenorientierung und Serviceorientierung mit einer Erfolgsbilanz beim Aufbau und der Aufrechterhaltung produktiver Stakeholder-Beziehungen

Fähigkeit, sich schnell an sich ändernde Aufgaben, Prioritäten und Geschäftsumgebungen anzupassen

Schweizer Re ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Rückversicherungen, Versicherungen und anderen Formen des versicherungsbasierten Risikotransfers und arbeitet daran, die Welt widerstandsfähiger zu machen. About the Team

The Data Management & Insights [DMI] team is responsible for making client data accessible to stakeholders by systematically acquiring and ingesting it. The team also utilizes advanced analytics techniques to generate valuable insights for L&H Reinsurance.

About the Role

The Data Management & Insights [DMI] team is responsible for making client data accessible to stakeholders by systematically acquiring and ingesting it. The team also utilizes advanced analytics techniques to generate valuable insights for L&H Reinsurance.
Since the entire team is in Bangalore, we are looking for this candidate to be in Bangalore for the best experience.

Main tasks/activities/responsibilities:

In this role you will have the following key business responsibilities:

• Design, map, code, and test onboarding of client datasets

• Perform data quality checks during data ingestion to ensure that end users can use the client data with minimal downstream enrichments

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities to optimize business processes

• Analyze and determine best path for solving business opportunities/issues which may include process improvements, application/system enhancements and/or end-user training

• Conduct data analysis to answer specific business questions or to support new initiatives.

About You:

• Understanding of ETL processing, and data integration concepts

• Experience in SQL and Python coding

• Good understanding of relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server etc.)

• Proven strategic, analytical, and conceptual thinking

• Effective communication skills, and the ability to present complex data and insights to stakeholders clearly and concisely
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Riguardo la nostra squadra

Siamo un team vario e dinamico di persone esperte e motivate che sono appassionate di risolvere problemi complessi attraverso disegni semplici ed intuitivi.

Il nostro Design Team è organizzato attorno ai prodotti. e lo sarete anche voi. Invece di progetti inscatolati nel tempo, siamo responsabili della progettazione di un paesaggio di prodotti in varie fasi del loro ciclo di vita.

Il nostro portafoglio di prodotti è costituito da oltre 150 applicazioni web e mobili che supportano funzioni di business riassicurative come Sales, Underwriting e Residui Management.

I nostri principi guida sono la collaborazione, il numero di persone che lavorano, l'agilità. Ci sforziamo di creare esperienze intuitive, di scalabilità e di impatto, aiutando i nostri utenti a lavorare in modo più efficace e sostenendo la missione di Swiss Re di affrontare alcune delle sfide più urgenti del mondo, tra cui il cambiamento climatico e la riduzione del divario di protezione.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Come designer UX/UI, aiuterai a modellare esperienze digitali intuitive, scalabili e di impatto su un portafoglio di prodotti. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con i proprietari dei prodotti, gli esperti di business, gli ingegneri e i colleghi designer per comprendere le esigenze degli utenti, definire soluzioni e offrire esperienze che bilanciano il valore degli utenti, gli obiettivi aziendali e la fattibilità tecnica.

Ci si aspetta di contribuire sia come progettista pratico che come partner strategico, aiutando i team a prendere decisioni informate sulla direzione del prodotto, la qualità dell'esperienza e l'usabilità a lungo termine.

Responsabilità chiave

- Guidare il processo di progettazione end-to-end dalla scoperta attraverso la consegna per uno o più prodotti digitali - Collaborare strettamente con i proprietari del prodotto, Business Experts, Engineers, e altri Designer per creare soluzioni desiderabili, realizzabili e valide - Condurre e applicare la ricerca degli utenti, test di usabilità, mapping di viaggio e altre pratiche di progettazione centrate sull'utente per informare le decisioni del prodotto - Creare wireframe, flussi utente, prototipi e progetti ad alta fedeltà utilizzando Figma e il nostro sistema di progettazione - Applicare modelli di UX stabiliti, principi di progettazione di interazione, e standard di accessibilità per

creare esperienze utente intuitive e coerenti - Contribuire alla strategia del prodotto individuando le esigenze, le opportunità e i miglioramenti dell'esperienza degli utenti nell'ecosistema più ampio del prodotto - Portare una prospettiva di progettazione dei sistemi e dei servizi per comprendere i flussi di lavoro end-to-end e identificare opportunità al di là di singoli schermi o funzionalità - Collaborare con team di ingegneria per garantire la qualità del design e l'implementazione di successo - Utilizzare dati, analisi e feedback degli utenti per valutare e migliorare continuamente le esperienze di prodotto - Contribuire all'evoluzione, governance e documentazione di

sistemi di progettazione, modelli UX, standard di accessibilità, risorse di progettazione riutilizzabili e orientamenti di progettazione che consentono coerenza e mobilità tra prodotti e team - esplora e applica tecnologie emergenti, tra cui flussi di lavoro di progettazione e sviluppo assistiti da AI, dove creano valore significativo per utenti e team - Aiutano a modellare esperienze che incorporano sistemi intelligenti, assicurando che rimangano comprensibili, affidabili e centrati sull'uomo

Di te

- 3 anni di esperienza in UX/UI, Product Design, Interaction Design, o un campo correlato (l'esperienza in ambienti B2B complessi è un plus) - Forte competenza in Figma e flussi di lavoro di design moderno - Capacità dimostrata di applicare modelli UX, principi di progettazione di interazione, architettura dell'informazione e best practice di progettazione visiva - Esperienza lavorando con sistemi di progettazione e approcci di progettazione basati su componenti; contributo ad un sistema di progettazione è un plus - Fa 1stile con standard di accessibilità e principi di progettazione inclusivi (WCAG conoscenza è un plus) - Comodo applicare il design centrato sull'utente

metodi, tra cui ricerca, test di usabilità, cartina di viaggio e design iterativo - Eccellente comunicazione, collaborazione, facilitazione e capacità di storyte-ling - Forte capacità organizzative con la capacità di gestire più priorità e chiaramente documentare decisioni di progettazione, modelli, standard e processi per diversi pubblico - Pensatore di sistemi in grado di bilanciare l'esecuzione di progettazione dettagliata con obiettivi più ampi di prodotto, servizio e business - Curioso di tecnologie emergenti, in particolare AI e automazione, e desideroso di esplorare come possono migliorare sia la pratica di progettazione e l'utente

esperienze - Confortevole ambiguità di navigazione, apprendimento continuo e aiutare i team a passare dalla complessità alla chiarezza

- E' bello avere

Oltre al tuo stipendio base, Swiss Re offre un interessante componente di compensazione variabile basato sulle prestazioni, progettato per riconoscere i tuoi risultati. Inoltre, godrai di una varietà di vantaggi globali e specifici per la posizione.

descriptionByLocale.en:
About our team

We are a diverse and dynamic team of experienced and motivated individuals who are passionate about solving complex problems through simple, intuitive designs.

Our Design Team is organized around products – and you will be too. Instead of time-boxed projects, we are responsible for the experience design of a landscape of products at various stages of their lifecycle.

Our product portfolio consists of more than 150 web and mobile applications supporting reinsurance business functions such as Sales, Underwriting, and Claims Management.

Our guiding principles are collaboration, pragmatism, and agility. We strive to create experiences that are intuitive, scalable, and impactful, helping our users work more effectively while supporting Swiss Re's mission to address some of the world's most urgent challenges, including climate change and closing the protection gap.

We are looking for a UX/UI Designer with a proven track record of designing high-quality digital experiences. Given the complexity of our industry, we value creative problem solvers who enjoy tackling sophisticated business, asking questions, addressing technical, and analytical challenges and translating them into meaningful user experiences.

About the role

As a UX/UI Designer, you will help shape intuitive, scalable, and impactful digital experiences across a portfolio of products. You will work closely with Product Owners, Business Experts, Engineers, and fellow Designers to understand user needs, define solutions, and deliver experiences that balance user value, business objectives, and technical feasibility.

You will be expected to contribute both as a hands-on designer and as a strategic partner, helping teams make informed decisions about product direction, experience quality, and long-term usability.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive the end-to-end design process from discovery through delivery for one or more digital products

• Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Experts, Engineers, and other Designers to create solutions that are desirable, feasible, and viable

• Conduct and apply user research, usability testing, journey mapping, and other user-centred design practices to inform product decisions

• Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs using Figma and our design system

• Apply established UX patterns, interaction design principles, and accessibility standards to create intuitive and consistent user experiences

• Contribute to product strategy by identifying user needs, opportunities, and experience improvements across the broader product ecosystem

• Bring a systems-thinking and service-design perspective to understand end-to-end workflows and identify opportunities beyond individual screens or features

• Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure design quality and successful implementation

• Use data, analytics, and user feedback to continuously evaluate and improve product experiences

• Contribute to the evolution, governance, and documentation of design systems, UX patterns, accessibility standards, reusable design assets, and design guidance that enable consistency and scalability across products and teams

• Explore and apply emerging technologies, including AI-assisted design and development workflows, where they create meaningful value for users and teams

• Help shape experiences that incorporate intelligent systems, ensuring they remain understandable, trustworthy, and human-centred

About you

• 3+ years of experience in UX/UI, Product Design, Interaction Design, or a related field (experience in complex B2B environments is a plus)

• Strong proficiency in Figma and modern design workflows

• Demonstrated ability to apply UX patterns, interaction design principles, information architecture, and visual design best practices

• Experience working with design systems and component-based design approaches; contributing to a design system is a plus

• Familiarity with accessibility standards and inclusive design principles (WCAG knowledge is a plus)

• Comfortable applying user-centred design methods, including research, usability testing, journey mapping, and iterative design

• Excellent communication, collaboration, facilitation, and storytelling skills

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and clearly document design decisions, patterns, standards, and processes for diverse audiences

• Systems thinker who can balance detailed design execution with broader product, service, and business goals

• Curious about emerging technologies, particularly AI and automation, and eager to explore how they can enhance both design practice and user experiences

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity, learning continuously, and helping teams move from complexity to clarity

Nice to Have

• Experience contributing to or maintaining design systems, accessibility standards, UX pattern libraries, or other shared design resources

• Experience working in agile product teams

• Experience designing complex enterprise or data-rich applications

• Familiarity with analytics tools and data-informed design practices

For Slovakia the base salary range for this position is between EUR 2,100 and EUR 3,400 per month (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers:​

• the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role, ​

• the applicant’s own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience.​
In addition to your base salary, Swiss Re offers an attractive performance-based variable compensation component, designed to recognise your achievements. Further you will enjoy a variety of global and location specific benefits.​
Eligibility may vary depending on the terms of Swiss Re policies and your employment contract.

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. intuitive und konsistente Benutzererfahrungen erstellen - Beitrag zur Produktstrategie durch die Identifizierung von Benutzerbedürfnissen, Möglichkeiten und Erfahrung Verbesserungen über das breitere Produktökosystem - Bringen Sie eine system-denkende und Service-Design-Perspektive zu verstehen, Ende-zu-Ende-Workflows und identifizieren Möglichkeiten über einzelne Bildschirme oder Funktionen hinaus - Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-Teams, um Designqualität und erfolgreiche Implementierung zu gewährleisten - Verwenden Sie Daten, Analysen und Benutzerfeedback, um kontinuierlich zu bewerten und verbessern Produkterfahrungen - Beitrag zur Entwicklung, Governance und Dokumentation von

Designsysteme, UX-Muster, Zugänglichkeitsstandards, wiederverwendbare Designwerte und Design-Leitlinien, die Konsistenz und Skalierbarkeit zwischen Produkten und Teams ermöglichen - Entdecken und anwenden neuer Technologien, einschließlich KI-unterstützter Design- und Entwicklungs-Workflows, wo sie einen sinnvollen Wert für Benutzer und Teams schaffen - Helfen Sie dabei, Erfahrungen zu gestalten, die intelligente Systeme integrieren, um zu gewährleisten, dass sie verständlich, vertrauenswürdig und menschlich ausgerichtet bleiben

Methoden, einschließlich Forschung, Usability Testing, Journey Mapping und iteratives Design - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation, Zusammenarbeit, Erleichterung und Storytelling Fähigkeiten - Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten zu verwalten und klar dokumentieren Design-Entscheidungen, Muster, Standards und Prozesse für vielfältige Zielgruppen - System-Denker, die detaillierte Design-Durchführung mit breiteren Produkt-, Service- und Geschäftsziele ausgleichen können - Neugierig über neue Technologien, insbesondere KI und Automatisierung, und eifrig zu erkunden, wie sie sowohl Design-Praxis als auch Benutzer verbessern können

Contribuirai inoltre attivamente alla ricerca e all'innovazione relativa al trasferimento di pericoli emergenti e di nuove soluzioni strutturali ai mercati dei capitali.
Le tue principali responsabilità includono anche:

• Sviluppare materiali client per nuove opportunità di transazione, preparare presentazioni per le discussioni degli investitori, e interagire direttamente con la C-suite di potenziali clienti

• Analizzare e ricercare le esposizioni dei clienti SRCM (paesi esteri, corporazioni, re/assicuratori e asset manager), e rivedere la documentazione delle transazioni come l'Offerta Circulars, Private Placement Memorandums e altri documenti simili

• Eseguire analisi finanziarie utilizzando tecniche di simulazione Monte Carlo e modelli di cash flow

• Viaggiare a incontri di clienti e investitori e impegnarsi attivamente nella discussione
Informazioni sulla squadra
Il team di strutturazione ILS di New York, basato su Swiss Re Capital Markets, è composto da persone con background diversi tra le banche di investimento, i mercati dei capitali, la riassicurazione e la modellazione della catastrofe. Questa posizione si baserà a New York, NY e riferirà direttamente al capo della ILS Structuring, Americas.
A proposito di te
Porti lo spirito imprenditoriale con alta energia e passione e fiorisci lavorando in un ambiente di squadra! Hai un record di successo che gestisce più progetti e scadenze simultanee in un ambiente dinamico e veloce. La tua professionalità quando interagisci con i clienti a livello C-suite lascia un'ottima impressione da parte tua e dell'azienda.
I requisiti chiave includono anche:

• Corso di laurea richiesto, con enfasi significativa in Matematica, Finanza, Economia o background analitico simile con un forte record di successo

• Minimo 3-5 anni di re / assicurazione, modellazione catastrofe, attuariale o esperienza bancaria di investimento richiesto

• Esposizione al legame di catastrofe, mercato ILS o processo di riassicurazione richiesto

• Eccezionale inglese scritto e verbale richiesto, tra cui grammatica eccellente, ortografia e attenzione ai dettagli in materiali di presentazione

• Le licenze esistenti nel settore dei titoli (cioè FINRA SIE, 7, 63, 79) hanno preferito, o sono in grado di acquisire licenze entro 60 giorni dall'occupazione
Informazioni su Swiss Re Capital Markets
Swiss Re Capital Markets (SRCM) è una banca di investimento boutique leader, che agisce come broker-dealer nella strutturazione, collocamento e trading secondario di ILS nei mercati dei capitali. ILS comprende obbligazioni di catastrofe, sidecar, soluzioni sintetiche e molti altri prodotti derivati e di securitizzazione. SRCM fornisce esigenze di copertura e finanziamento dei rischi per una varietà di clienti, tra cui re / assicuratori, governi e aziende, con competenze sia nel settore della proprietà e della vita e della salute. I rischi trasferiti nelle transazioni ILS possono variare da disastri naturali e malattie pandemiche fino ad eventi di rischio o di terrore.
Siamo lieti della vostra applicazione!
La nostra azienda utilizza un modello di lavoro ibrido che richiede almeno tre giorni in ufficio ogni settimana, con la possibilità di lavorare in loco a tempo pieno se preferito. Questa posizione non è ammissibile per il telelavoro a tempo pieno o la sponsorizzazione del visto.

L'intervallo di stipendio base stimato per questa posizione è di $ 132,000 a $198,000. Lo stipendio specifico offerto per questo o qualsiasi dato ruolo terrà conto di un certo numero di fattori, tra cui, ma non solo, la posizione del lavoro, la portata del ruolo, le qualifiche, la complessità/specializzazione/scarsità del talento, l'esperienza, l'istruzione e il bilancio del datore di lavoro. A Swiss Re, prendiamo un "approccio di compensazione totale" quando prendiamo decisioni di risarcimento. Ciò significa che consideriamo tutti i componenti di compensazione nella loro totalità (come la retribuzione base, gli incentivi a breve e a lungo termine e i benefici offerti), nella definizione di una compensazione individuale.
Informazioni su Swiss Re
Svizzera Re è uno dei principali fornitori mondiali di riassicurazione, assicurazione e altre forme di trasferimento di rischio basato su assicurazione, lavorando per rendere il mondo più resiliente. Aspettiamo e gestiamo una vasta gamma di rischi, dalle catastrofi naturali e dai cambiamenti climatici al cybercrimine. Combinando l'esperienza con il pensiero creativo e l'esperienza all'avanguardia, creiamo nuove opportunità e soluzioni per i nostri clienti. Questo è possibile grazie alla collaborazione di oltre 15.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo.

Il nostro successo dipende dalla nostra capacità di costruire una cultura inclusiva che incoraggia prospettive fresche e pensiero innovativo. Abbracciamo un posto di lavoro dove ognuno ha pari opportunità per prosperare e sviluppare professionalmente indipendentemente dalla loro età, sesso, razza, etnia, identità di genere e/o espressione, orientamento sessuale, capacità fisica o mentale, abilità, pensiero o altre caratteristiche. Nel nostro ambiente inclusivo e flessibile tutti possono portare il proprio sé autentico a lavorare e la loro passione per la sostenibilità.

Se sei un professionista esperto che torna alla forza lavoro dopo una pausa di carriera, ti invitiamo a candidarti per posizioni aperte che corrispondono alle tue competenze e esperienza.

Svizzera Re è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. È la nostra pratica di reclutare, assumere e promuovere senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, disabilità, età, gravidanza, orientamento sessuale, stato civile, stato militare, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge. Le decisioni sull'occupazione si basano esclusivamente sulle qualifiche di un individuo per la posizione in essere.

Durante il processo di reclutamento, su richiesta sono disponibili sistemazioni ragionevoli per disabili. Se contattato per un colloquio, si prega di informare il Recruiter/HR Professional dell'alloggio necessario.

Possiamo utilizzare strumenti basati su AI per supportare la revisione e la valutazione delle applicazioni per questa posizione. Questi strumenti forniscono ulteriori informazioni ai nostri team di reclutamento, ma tutte le decisioni di assunzione sono attentamente esaminate e fatte dalle persone. Per saperne di più su come utilizziamo l'IA nel reclutamento e come gestiamo i tuoi dati personali, si prega di rivedere la nostra Informativa sulla privacy dei dati prima di applicare.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you thrive in an empowering, fast-paced and international environment? Able to build your expertise and grow your responsibilities rapidly in the right setting? We are seeking a motivated, entrepreneurial and energetic professional to join Swiss Re Capital Markets (SRCM) Insurance-Linked Securities (ILS) Structuring team as an ILS Structurer at the Assistant Vice President Level, where you'll help bridge the gap between global capital markets and the (re)insurance industry.
About the Role
This role is pivotal in supporting the origination, pricing, structuring, and execution of ILS transactions—including catastrophe bonds—for Swiss Re Capital Markets’ diverse portfolio of clients. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including competing investment banks, risk modelers, rating agencies and legal firms on the placement of new issue securities. You will also actively contribute to the research and innovation related to transferring emerging perils and new structural solutions to the capital markets.
Your main responsibilities will also include :

• Develop client materials for new transaction opportunities, prepare presentations for investor discussions, and interact directly with the C-suite of prospective clients

• Analyze and research the exposures of SRCM clients (sovereign nations, corporations, re/insurers and asset managers), and review transaction documentation such as Offering Circulars, Private Placement Memorandums and other similar documents

• Perform financial analyses using Monte Carlo simulation techniques and cash flow models

• Travel to client and investor meetings and actively engage in the discussion
About the Team
Swiss Re Capital Markets New York-based ILS structuring team is composed of individuals with diverse backgrounds across investment banking, capital markets, reinsurance and catastrophe modeling. This position will be based in New York, NY and report directly to the Head of ILS Structuring, Americas.
About You
You bring entrepreneurial spirit with high energy and passion and flourish working in a team environment! You have a successful track record managing multiple simultaneous projects and deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Your professionalism when interacting with C-suite-level clients leaves an excellent impression of you and the company.
Key requirements also include :

• Bachelor's degree required, with significant emphasis in Mathematics, Finance, Economics or similar analytical background with a strong record of achievement

• Minimum 3-5 years' re/insurance, catastrophe modeling, actuarial or investment banking experience required

• Exposure to the catastrophe bond, ILS market or reinsurance placement process required

• Outstanding written and verbal English required, including excellent grammar, spelling and attention to detail in presentation materials

• Existing securities industry licensing (i.e. FINRA SIE, 7, 63, 79) preferred, or capable of acquiring licenses within 60-days of employment
About Swiss Re Capital Markets
Swiss Re Capital Markets (SRCM) is a leading boutique investment bank, acting as broker-dealer in the structuring, placement and secondary trading of ILS in the capital markets. ILS includes catastrophe bonds, sidecars, synthetic solutions and many other securitization and derivative products. SRCM provides risk hedging and financing needs to a variety of clients, including re/insurers, governments and corporations, with expertise in both the property & casualty and life and health sectors. Risks transferred in ILS transactions can range from natural disasters and pandemic diseases all the way to cyber risk or terror events.
We are looking forward to your application!
Our company uses a hybrid work model requiring at least three days in the office each week, with the option to work onsite full-time if preferred. This position is not eligible for full-time telework or visa sponsorship.

The estimated base salary range for this position is $132,000 to $198,000. The specific salary offered for this or any given role will take into account a number of factors including but not limited to job location, scope of role, qualifications, complexity/specialization/scarcity of talent, experience, education, and employer budget. At Swiss Re, we take a "total compensation approach" when making compensation decisions. This means that we consider all components of compensation in their totality (such as base pay, short-and long-term incentives, and benefits offered), in setting individual compensation.
About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

Swiss Re is an equal opportunity employer. It is our practice to recruit, hire and promote without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, pregnancy, sexual orientations, marital status, military status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Decisions on employment are solely based on an individual's qualifications for the position being filled.

During the recruitment process, reasonable accommodations for disabilities are available upon request. If contacted for an interview, please inform the Recruiter/HR Professional of the accommodation needed.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.
